records.source_comment:
This reference organ, Right-kidney-female (https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library) was created using data from the
Visible Human Dataset, provided by the National Library of Medicine (Spitzer and Whitlock 2002). In version v1.3,
changes include removing the renal calyces and renal papillae and adding them to the ureter model per subject matter
expert input.

**Bibliography:**

* Spitzer, Victor M., and David G. Whitlock. 2002. “The Visible Human Dataset: The Anatomical Platform for Human Simulation.” *The Anatomical Record* 253 (2): 49–57. https://doi.org/10.1002/(SICI)1097-0185(199804)253:2<49::AID-AR8>3.0.CO;2-9.

records.source_comment:
This reference organ, Right-renal-pelvis-female (https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library) was created using data
from the Visible Human Dataset, provided by the National Library of Medicine (Spitzer and Whitlock 2002).

**Bibliography:**

* Spitzer, Victor M., and David G. Whitlock. 2002. “The Visible Human Dataset: The Anatomical Platform for Human Simulation.” *The Anatomical Record* 253 (2): 49–57. https://doi.org/10.1002/(SICI)1097-0185(199804)253:2<49::AID-AR8>3.0.CO;2-9.

holds: Kidney/ureter version comments describe papilla relocation, but actual kidney v1.3 includes ten papilla-labelled primitives and ureter v1.2 has no papilla-labelled primitive. Preserve geometry and reconcile source metadata before clinical binding.
Standalone renal-pelvis crosswalk is right-specific while GLB extras carry a generic pelvis identifier; both source descriptions remain preserved pending semantic specialization review.
Standalone renal-pelvis position and index accessor bytes match the pelvis primitive in the ureter asset; do not double-count anatomy.

Open per-part boundaries may be intended interfaces; kidney renal-column source also retains two zero-area triangles and exact-position nonmanifold edges. No repair or continuity/clinical assumption is granted.
Source asset authors/reviewers are metadata facts, not inherited approval of Primer conversion, measured original imaging resolution or all reporting structures.
